caption:
Standing tasking runs across multiple areas of interest every week. Each pass is logged and closed out whether or not it turns up anything worth escalating.

The volume is real: dozens of monitored sites, hundreds of collection passes, cycling on schedule regardless of season, weekend, or news cycle. That's the baseline the analysis rests on — not a one-off look after something already happened.

What this post will not say: which sites, whose infrastructure, or what turned up. Naming any of that defeats the purpose of the collection plan. The tempo is the story here, not the target.

card.headline: The rotation doesn't pause for weekends
